1) a hybrid classifier that combines human and machine intelligence can significantly reduce the human effort required for text classification; and 2) the resulting hybrid classifier can achieve higher accuracy than machine-learning based classifiers, when a comparable amount human effort is used.

(i) a human-in-the-loop text classifier that uses automatically discovered text patterns can achieve a given level of accuracy using less human labeling effort, compared to a pure machine-learning based classifier, (ii) a human-in-theloop text classifier can achieve a higher accuracy using a given amount of labeled data, compared to a machine-learning based classifier.

(1) a hybrid approach combining human reasoning with machine learning results in significantly higher classification accuracy than either approach alone and (2) this hybrid approach requires significantly less human effort than either approach alone.
